name: PhotoCraft v0.3.0
body:
## Highlights since 0.2.0

182 commits from 183 merged pull requests, including work from 31 community contributors (thank you!), and 146 issues closed.

- **Your work is safer:**
  - Recovered unsaved documents survive a second crash.
  - Deeply nested `.pcraft` files reopen.
  - `photocraft-cli batch` refuses to overwrite its input folder.
  - Preferences no longer get lost when two windows or tabs save, or when a save fails.
- **Languages:** the interface is available in 日本語, 简体中文, 繁體中文, Español, Русский and Čeština (Edit › Preferences › Interface › Language), with CJK fonts and IME input in the Type tool.
- **Files:**
  - JPEG and other no-alpha exports composite transparency over white.
  - Formats without colour profiles get sRGB.
  - Truncated JPEGs and multi-frame files open with a warning instead of silently.
  - TGA is offered in Save As and Export As.
- **Editing:**
  - Free Transform a Copy and Transform Again on a Copy.
  - Keyboard layer navigation, number keys for opacity, Alt-click colour sampling.
  - New from Clipboard.
  - Undo and redo restore the targeted layer.
  - Shortcuts pressed in quick succession all run, in order.
- **Automation (CLI, MCP, control channel):**
  - Stricter, clearer parameter and flag errors, and `<subcommand> --help`.
  - Background jobs that agents can wait for or poll.
  - Recorded actions run in `batch`.

## Scorecard

This is the first release with [`docs/scorecard.md`](https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/blob/v0.3.0/docs/scorecard.md), so these numbers are its baseline. 0.2.0 had no scorecard to compare against. Area counts are done / partial / missing.

| Area | Done | Partial | Missing | Measured |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Performance | 3 | 22 | 12 | 46 scenarios: 3 within budget, 22 over budget or failing, 13 tracked only, 4 not run, 8 not yet measurable (baseline 2026-10-05) |
| File compatibility | 1 | 8 | 18 | io corpus oracle ≥ 146/170, round trip ≥ 169/170; psd-tools oracle ≥ 229/309, round trip ≥ 307/309; Photoshop-authored oracles ≥ 130/256, round trip 258/258 |
| Tools | 3 | 14 | 13 | |
| Workspace and UI | 0 | 4 | 19 | settings that do nothing: 60 of 133 (target 0) |
| Type | 0 | 3 | 6 | |
| Automation | 1 | 3 | 7 | 626 of 626 menu items live |
| Reliability | 3 | 1 | 3 | never-crash lints on 26 of 26 crates; `panic_hunt` fuzzes every command |
| Distribution | 4 | 3 | 4 | |
| Open bugs | 0 | 3 | 29 | |
